marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Supply Chain Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading US hyperscalers reported a 25% year-over-year increase in quarterly AI capital expenditures, boosting semiconductor and server hardware providers.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained hardware demand continues to anchor bullish sentiment across US large-cap tech, delivering positive spillover to Asia-Pacific hardware exporters.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of valuation fatigue and supply chain bottlenecks limiting short-term shipment fulfillment.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet & E-commerce Profitability Focus
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech platforms announced expanded share buyback initiatives alongside improved operating margins across cloud and international operations.
marketLayer.inference: Capital return strategies are successfully establishing a valuation floor, accelerating Southbound capital inflows through the Stock Connect channel.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistently weak domestic retail sales figures impacting forward core revenue growth.

marketLayer.title: Fed-PBOC Policy Alignment & Rate Environment
marketLayer.fact: US 10-year Treasury yields stabilized following soft labor market data, while the PBOC conducted net liquidity injections through medium-term lending facilities.
marketLayer.inference: Easing yield pressures create a favorable liquidity backdrop for high-yield Hong Kong equities and interest-rate-sensitive US growth stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky service sector inflation delaying anticipated interest rate adjustments.
